email.subject: Inquiry: Sovereign Knowledge Retrieval with pgvector
email.body:
Hello NovaCorp Team,

We require an enterprise document search system using pgvector and multi-tenant partitioning for our financial analysis team. Can you confirm if your platform provides query-level tenant isolation, AES-256 encryption at rest, and support for PDF/DOCX ingestion?

Looking forward to your proposal.

Best,
CTO, FinTech Client

expected_behavior.scenario: Fully supported request with direct matches in knowledge base
